A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the natural siderophores pyoverdine and pyochelin are not only the main siderophores of fluorescent pseudomonads and non-fluorescent pseudomonads respectively, they are also the main iron carriers in the rhizosphere.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the PchR proteins are stereospecific for ferri-pyocelin, which is the natural ligand for these regulators.
the enantiomers of the natural sideropyochelins are not equally recognized by PchR, but that PchR from different species of Pseudomonads differ in the stereospecificity of their siderophore binding.
pyochelin and its enantiomer bind to PchR with similar affinities, which is in agreement with the similar transcriptional activation of pyochelin biosynthesis and uptake by both enantiomers.
